scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "bun --cwd apps/web dev" "bun --cwd apps/api dev"
scripts.build: bun run typecheck && bun --cwd apps/web build && bun --cwd apps/api build
scripts.test: bun --cwd packages/game-data test && bun --cwd packages/game-engine test && bun --cwd apps/web test && bun --cwd apps/api test
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd packages/contracts typecheck && bun --cwd packages/game-data typecheck && bun --cwd packages/game-engine typecheck && bun --cwd apps/web typecheck && bun --cwd apps/api typecheck
